name: theme-provider
title: Theme Provider
description: Generates a primary color palette from a single hex color and applies it as CSS custom properties.

docs.lead: Dynamically override HapplyUI's primary color palette at runtime by providing a single base hex color. Uses OKLCH color space for perceptually uniform scale generation.

examples.title: Scoped (default)
examples.description: Wraps children in a div with CSS custom properties. Each provider can have a different primary color.

examples.title: Global
examples.description: Applies the generated palette to :root, overriding the default theme globally.

examples.title: Multiple themes
examples.description: Use scoped providers side by side to show different brand colors.
examples.code: Rose Blue

api.name: ThemeProvider.Root
api.description: Generates a full primary color scale from a hex color and injects CSS custom properties.

props.name: primaryColor
props.description: Base hex color (e.g. '#7d52f4'). Used to generate the full 50–950 scale.

props.name: scope
props.description: Whether to apply vars to a wrapper div (scoped) or to :root (global).

props.name: darkMode
props.description: Strategy for detecting dark mode. 'media' uses prefers-color-scheme, 'class' watches for a .dark class on <html>.
